meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion on Invoice Mismatch: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as an AP Executive on a tenant below the Growth plan and verify the auto-suggestion capability is absent or refused
Use Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion for an invoice mismatch where an invoiced item is not found on the PO
Repeat the same workflow on a Growth tenant and verify the capability is available
Compare the capability outcome across tenants with different subscription plans
